title: 目標達成の後に・最終決戦へ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital has finished her spring tour of the senior G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What's the word, Trainer? What do you think of my results?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I've been running constantly just like we planned, right? It's been amazing, right? Nudge, nudge!
choice_data_list: You're not just an all-rounder, you're the All-Rounder!
You're not just an all-rounder, you're the All-Rounder!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, hearing that never gets old! ♪ Guess I'll keep doing what I need to live up to that praise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She certainly has been exceptional. And now…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The time has come. A battle to rival Sekigahara… Hulao Pass… Midnight on merch drop days! In other words—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's go time! I'll be going up against Opera O and Doto in the battle to end all battles!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I've experienced so many things leading up to this point.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I've grappled with countless runners on both turf and dirt.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I may not have any distinguishing strengths, but I stand out by taking on anyone, anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Each step I've taken has set the stage for what's now to come!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll put all of the experience I've gained running both turf and dirt to good use… and I'll overcome my two idols!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And not only that, my performance itself will be a celebration symbolizing how utterly magnificent Umamusume are! It's the ultimate simping!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's time to put "Project Digitan" into action! Trainer, which racecourse should be the stage for my great finale this fall?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A true hero doesn't choose their battlefield, but let's make an exception today. Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We put our heads together to think.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: First of all, we can forget about dirt. Of the three of us, I'm the only one of us who can run on it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That rules out miles as well. I'm fine with short distances, but the others are better built for medium and long-distance.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: With that in mind, how about…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: HWHAT?! Say that one more time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I was thinking exactly the same thing, and you repeating it just sealed the deal.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What better place to bring out the best in Opera O and Doto than a 2,000-meter turf race at Tokyo Racecourse?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And that's where I'll do it! I'm gonna be a star! No! Even better—I'm gonna be an oshi!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uhhh, why wouldn't it be?
choice_data_list: You're putting yourself at a disadvantage.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh… Well…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: 2,000 meters of Tokyo turf truly makes for the quintessential medium-distance race. It's the perfect stage to test one's true ability.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no trick that will guarantee a win. Skill and skill alone must carry us to victory against opponents as powerful as T.M. Opera O and Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You're absolutely right, but… what are you gonna do? It's just my nature.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I wanna see my adorable Umas where they can shine their brightest!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna drag them into my lane and cheese a win. At that point, I'd rather just not run in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Shine bright, my Umas! And shine even brighter, Digitan!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: This is what it means to be cool! This is the definition of simping!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: So, are you with me, Trainer? Will you indulge me in this?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I knew you were a real one!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Not that I ever doubted you, hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital knows no doubt—it isn't in her DNA as an obsessive fangirl.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The exceptional All-Rounder is running in the autumn Tenno Sho. And the news spreads like wildfire throughout Tracen Academy.
